## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4005. The issue was that storefront-web 3.0 has a backend dependency on the pricing-api service, but the readiness probe doesn't verify this dependency. While the pods appear Running and Ready to Kubernetes, they fail when receiving actual requests because they can't reach the pricing-api.

The fix is to update the readiness probe to check the availability of the pricing-api service before marking pods as ready, which will prevent nginx from routing requests to pods that can't handle them. This aligns with Kubernetes best practices for applications with backend service dependencies.
